visual_action: The video begins with a static image of a simulated tweet from an account named 'FactPost'. The tweet announces that Abigail Spanberger has been elected Governor of Virginia and includes a photo of her next to a photo of the Virginia State Capitol. After a few seconds, it cuts to a single, steady shot of Abigail Spanberger sitting in a leather chair in a formal office setting, looking directly at the camera with a serious expression.
